capture_method: Paired native Qt raster output using extracted original and Fontreal Qt distro libraries. Shared integer physical baselines and identical requested font files, style, pixel size, scale, text, palette and canvas. Actual Qt advances are retained, so output spacing can differ. UI images are actual QWidget grabs, isolated Konsole X11 screen captures, and retained validated Plasma Wayland session captures.
processing: RGB PNG crops and integer-position copies only. No interpolation, sharpening, recoloring, or retouch.
view: Open the original PNG at one image pixel per display pixel. README preview resizing, browser zoom and display scaling can alter presentation.
